info.name: OutfitShop SS-MIS API
info.description:
Complete collection — 194 endpoints across 4 RBAC tiers.

Base URL: https://api.kesararamwithdigital.tech/api/v1

HOW TO START:
1. Open folder '00 - Login' and run the role you want.
2. Token is saved automatically to {{token}}.
3. Every request already has the token — just hit Send.

TIER 1  PUBLIC         — No token needed
TIER 2  AUTHENTICATED  — Any logged-in employee
TIER 3  MANAGER        — MANAGER or ADMIN role
TIER 4  ADMIN          — ADMIN role only

Live IDs used:
  product_id   = 182
  variant_id   = 174
  barcode      = SKU-GUC-0182
  brand_id     = 3
  category_id  = 14
  size_id      = 1
  color_id     = 1
  employee_id  = 1
  order_id     = 1
